title: Annotated Rigol digital multimeter diagram
visual_facts: A labeled front-panel diagram of a digital multimeter fills the image.
The instrument brand and model are marked RIGOL and DM3058.
Red arrows identify the LCD Display, Direction Keys, Power Key, USB Host, and Signal Input Terminal.
Other callouts name Yellow District: Trigger Control Keys, Gray District: Measurement Function Keys, Blue District: Assistant Function Keys, and Menu Operation Keys.
Four circular input terminals and grouped rectangular buttons are drawn on the panel.
spatial_relations: The LCD is in the upper center of the panel.
The input terminals form a cluster at the upper right.
The power key and USB port are on the left side.
uncertainties: The diagram does not show the physical instrument or its operating state.
Some tiny button symbols are not legible.
